properties.line: Niagara Frontier Transportation Authority: Metro Rail
properties.speed_source: estimated: light rail with frequent stops, surface running on the Main Street Transit Mall downtown and its own right-of-way further north; unsourced

segments.note: Demonstration service began Oct 1, 1984 on the Main Street Transit Mall (Auditorium-Theater, weekdays only). Regular service opened May 20, 1985 from Theater to Amherst Street; the line reached its current northern terminus at University (formerly South Campus) on Nov 10, 1986, completing the 6.4-mile route from the Lake Erie waterfront to the University at Buffalo campus. Downtown stations (roughly Canalside to Theater) have been fare-free since opening. Frequency estimated, unsourced.
